points.quote: This may include work produced by, but not attributed to: another student, an essay mill 4, a family member or friend, a tutoring service or the unauthorised use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) software.
points.gist: False authorship can include work produced by but not attributed to others, including unauthorised use of AI software.

points.quote: The ‘false authorship’ may relate to the student engaging with a third party and/or software tool to complete an assessment, either in part or whole.
points.gist: False authorship may involve using a third party or software tool to complete an assessment, in part or whole.
